title: Welcome to my journal
excerpt: A sample article to demonstrate the journal. Replace it with your own introduction.
takeaway: A useful journal starts with one clear idea and an example that makes it concrete.
body:
## Why I write

This is example content. Use this space to introduce your interests and explain what readers can expect.

## What you can expect

- Project stories and design decisions
- Practical guides
- Notes on lessons learned

## A small example

**Keep the idea clear.** A short code example can help:

```js
const greeting = 'Hello, world!';
console.log(greeting);
```

| Section | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Projects | Show your work |
| Guides | Explain an idea |
| Notes | Share a lesson |
